title: 汉字拆解 Hanzi Breakdown — Batch 2
description: Character decomposition and memory aids for Song Dynasty vocabulary (new words)

characters.breakdown: 拿着笔（聿），一步步走出去（廴）建造东西
characters.memory_tip: Pick up a brush (聿) and walk forward (廴) — step by step, you build something → 建

characters.breakdown: 一个人叉开双腿，稳稳站在地上
characters.memory_tip: A person (大) standing firmly on the ground (一) — feet planted → stand → 立

characters.breakdown: 在屋子（宀）里稳稳地站定（疋），不再移动
characters.memory_tip: Under a roof (宀), feet planted steady (疋) — settled, not moving → fix / decide → 定

characters.breakdown: 聚集了所有人（者）的大城市（邑）
characters.memory_tip: The place (阝) where everyone (者) gathers → the capital city → 都

components.meaning: to govern / hand holding a staff

characters.breakdown: 手持权杖（尹），开口发号施令（口）
characters.memory_tip: A hand holding a staff (尹) and a mouth giving orders (口) — that's a ruler → 君

characters.breakdown: 用手（扌）掌握空间（空），不让它乱跑
characters.memory_tip: A hand (扌) gripping the empty space (空) — holding everything in check → control → 控

components.meaning: tree with branches — not yet / undecided

characters.breakdown: 用刀（刂）把乱长的树枝（未）修剪整齐，制定规矩
characters.memory_tip: A knife (刂) trimming wild branches (未) into order — imposing a system → 制

characters.breakdown: 用刀（刀）把牛角（角）从牛（牛）身上切开
characters.memory_tip: A knife (刀) separating a horn (角) from an ox (牛) — cutting apart, untying → 解

characters.breakdown: 把多余（余）的土堆（阝）铲掉，清除干净
characters.memory_tip: Scrape away the surplus (余) from the earthen mound (阝) — remove what's extra → 除

characters.breakdown: 手（又）握住大树（木）——掌握了力量
characters.memory_tip: A hand (又) gripping a tree (木) — holding firm, not letting go → power / authority → 权

characters.breakdown: 手持武器的士兵（戌）让人（女）感到恐惧和敬畏
characters.memory_tip: An armed soldier (戌) intimidating others (女) — awe and fear → might → 威

characters.breakdown: 三股力量（劦）同时压向身体（月），迫使就范
characters.memory_tip: Three forces (劦) pressing on the body (月) from the sides — squeezed and threatened → 胁

components.meaning: to arrange / separate into a row

characters.breakdown: 衣服（衣）被撕裂，分成了一列一列（列）
characters.memory_tip: Cloth (衣) torn into separate strips (列) — ripped apart → split → 裂

characters.breakdown: 在屋子（宀）里，大白天（日）设宴款待宾客
characters.memory_tip: Under a roof (宀), in the bright daytime (日), a hostess (女) entertains guests → banquet → 宴

characters.breakdown: 大家一起用手把东西高高举起来
characters.memory_tip: Many hands (手) working together to lift something high — raise up → 举

characters.breakdown: 一个人（亻）正直（直），所以有价值
characters.memory_tip: A person (亻) who is upright and straight (直) — that's someone of worth → 值

characters.breakdown: 睁大眼睛（见）仔细看，形成自己的看法
characters.memory_tip: Open eyes (见) watching carefully — forming a perspective → 观

characters.meaning: thought / idea / to think of / to read aloud
characters.breakdown: 此刻（今）心里（心）想着的东西
characters.memory_tip: What's on your heart (心) right now (今) — a thought lingering in the mind → 念

characters.breakdown: 用行动（攵）打乱原来的样子，让它改变
characters.memory_tip: A strike (攵) disrupts the tangled threads at the top — breaking the old pattern → change → 变

characters.meaning: to slaughter / to rule over / prime minister

components.meaning: roof / house — authority over a domain

characters.breakdown: 屋子（宀）里掌管一切辛苦事务（辛）的人
characters.memory_tip: Under the roof (宀) managing all the hard work (辛) — the one in charge → prime minister → 宰

characters.breakdown: 用眼睛（目）仔细观察树木（木），互相看清对方
characters.memory_tip: An eye (目) examining a tree (木) closely — looking carefully at each other → observe / minister → 相

characters.breakdown: 有了钱财（贝），才（才）算有了资本
characters.memory_tip: Shells (贝) are the original currency, and talent (才) earns it — wealth → 财

characters.breakdown: 用行动（攵）维持正确（正）的秩序
characters.memory_tip: Enforcing (攵) what is correct (正) — keeping order through action → government → 政

characters.breakdown: 把粮食（禾）换成（兑）钱交给国家
characters.memory_tip: Grain (禾) converted (兑) into money for the state — taxation → 税

characters.breakdown: 用手（攵）把散落的东西收拢起来
characters.memory_tip: A striking hand (攵) gathering scattered things together — harvest / collect → 收

characters.breakdown: 手（又）用力向反方向推，把东西翻过来
characters.memory_tip: A hand (又) pushing back against the overhang (厂) — pushing in the opposite direction → oppose / reverse → 反

characters.breakdown: 用手（又）精确地（寸）对准目标
characters.memory_tip: A hand (又) measuring precisely (寸) — facing something exactly → correct / oppose → 对

characters.breakdown: 太阳（日）加月亮（月），两个都亮，当然明！
characters.memory_tip: Sun (日) + Moon (月) shining together — brilliantly bright and clear → 明

characters.breakdown: 在阳光（日）下高高展示（业），一眼就能看见
characters.memory_tip: Something raised up (业) under sunlight (日) — impossible to miss → evident → 显

characters.breakdown: 大家共用（共）的蜿蜒小路（己）
characters.memory_tip: A winding path (己) shared (共) by everyone in the neighbourhood → alley → 巷

components.meaning: mortar — a hollow vessel, something held up from below

characters.breakdown: 大家一起（共）把东西高高托起来（臼），欣欣向荣
characters.memory_tip: Everyone (共) lifting something up together from below (臼) — rising with shared energy → prosper → 兴

characters.breakdown: 盘子（皿）里盛满了成功（成）的果实
characters.memory_tip: A vessel (皿) filled to the brim with success (成) — overflowing abundance → flourishing → 盛

characters.breakdown: 人（亻）突然（乍）动起来，开始做事
characters.memory_tip: A person (亻) suddenly springing into action (乍) — doing something → 作

characters.breakdown: 拿着武器（戈）与单独的对手（单）对打
characters.memory_tip: A forked weapon (单) clashing with a spear (戈) — head-to-head combat → battle → 战

characters.breakdown: 手里的东西从指缝间滑落，丢掉了
characters.memory_tip: Something slipping through an open hand — lost, gone → 失

characters.breakdown: 用刀（刂）割收庄稼（禾），收获利益
characters.memory_tip: A knife (刂) cutting through grain (禾) — sharp and efficient, bringing gain → 利

characters.breakdown: 手持工具（工）主动出击（攵）
characters.memory_tip: Using tools (工) to strike (攵) — taking offensive action → attack → 攻

characters.breakdown: 插下旗帜（卜），大声宣告（口）这里是我的地盘
characters.memory_tip: Plant a flag (卜) and declare (口) 'this is mine!' → occupy → 占

characters.meaning: to capture / abduct / carry off by force
characters.breakdown: 用手（扌）抓住俘虏（虏）带走
characters.memory_tip: A hand (扌) grabbing a prisoner (虏) and dragging them off → abduct → 掳

characters.breakdown: 古字像一个人跳舞，后来借用为'没有'的意思
characters.memory_tip: Originally a dancing figure — borrowed to mean 'nothing' because the movement leaves nothing behind → 无

components.meaning: two claws — a bear's powerful paws

characters.breakdown: 像熊一样（月+匕匕），身体强壮，什么都能做
characters.memory_tip: A bear's powerful body (月) with strong claws (匕匕) — capable of anything → able → 能

characters.breakdown: 像治水（氵）一样，从高台（台）上统筹管理
characters.memory_tip: Like controlling the flow of water (氵) from an elevated platform (台) — managing with authority → govern → 治

components.meaning: an eye looking sideways and downward (ancient pictograph)

characters.breakdown: 古字像一只眼睛向下看，表示臣子低头服从君主
characters.memory_tip: An eye (臣) looking downward in submission — bowing before the ruler → minister → 臣

characters.breakdown: 用纤维（纟）为基础（氏）制成的薄片
characters.memory_tip: Fibres (纟) pressed into a flat base (氏) — the material of paper → 纸

characters.breakdown: 古代用布帛（巾）当货币，后来专指钱
characters.memory_tip: In ancient times, cloth (巾) was used as currency — a stamped piece of fabric with value → 币

characters.breakdown: 用少量的金属（钅）价值来代表大额的钱
characters.memory_tip: A little metal (钅少) standing in for much larger value — a note, not a coin → banknote → 钞

characters.meaning: to issue / send out / emit / hair
characters.breakdown: 手拉弓（弓），两脚迈开（癶），把东西射发出去
characters.memory_tip: Feet apart (癶), hand (又) drawing a bow (弓) — and releasing → send out / issue → 发

characters.meaning: to go / carry out / profession / row
characters.breakdown: 左脚（彳）右脚（亍）交替迈出，走起来了
characters.memory_tip: Left step (彳) + right step (亍) — walking in motion → to go / carry out → 行

characters.breakdown: 女子（女）载歌载舞，让人开心（吴）
characters.memory_tip: A woman (女) singing and performing (吴) — bringing joy and amusement → entertainment → 娱

components.meaning: white / bright — the sound ringing out

characters.breakdown: 古字像一架木制乐器上绑着丝弦，弹奏出美妙声音
characters.memory_tip: Strings stretched over wood (木) — a musical instrument making bright (白) sound → music / joy → 乐

characters.breakdown: 手持旗帜（巾），让所有人俯首听命（卩）
characters.memory_tip: The one holding the banner (巾) that everyone (卩) bows to → commander → 帅

characters.breakdown: 古义：能拿着武器（戈）让战争停止（止）才是真武
characters.memory_tip: A spear (戈) used to make war stop (止) — true martial power brings peace → 武

components.meaning: sprout / to grow in a winding way

characters.breakdown: 像植物（艹）一样，从小慢慢（乙）长出来的本领
characters.memory_tip: A skill that grows (艹) slowly and organically (乙) — cultivated over time → art / skill → 艺

components.meaning: a plant that endures hardship (also phonetic)

characters.breakdown: 像植物（堇）那样，默默用力（力）生长，从不懈怠
characters.memory_tip: The strength (力) of a plant (堇) that pushes through hardship without stopping → diligent → 勤

characters.breakdown: 像鸟（隹）从田野（田）上大力（大）振翅飞起
characters.memory_tip: A bird (隹) powerfully (大) launching from the field (田) — soaring with effort → strive → 奋

characters.breakdown: 用力气（力）努力干活（工），得到了功劳
characters.memory_tip: Work (工) + strength (力) = merit earned through effort → 功

components.meaning: tribal chief / aged wine (symbol of seniority)

characters.breakdown: 对长者（酋）恭敬地（寸）鞠躬行礼
characters.memory_tip: Bowing carefully (寸) before the elder chief (酋) — showing deep respect → 尊

components.meaning: action / to strike — here: to urge oneself

characters.breakdown: 时刻督促（攵）自己谨慎认真（苟），表现出恭敬
characters.memory_tip: Constantly urging (攵) yourself to be careful and conscientious (苟) → sincere respect → 敬

characters.breakdown: 遇到阻碍（艮），只好走（辶）回头
characters.memory_tip: Hitting a wall (艮) and walking (辶) away from it — forced to step back → retreat → 退

characters.breakdown: 张口呼唤（口），如刀声令下（刀），叫人过来
characters.memory_tip: A sharp command (刀) from a calling mouth (口) — summoning someone → 召

components.meaning: witch / shaman — someone who deceives with dark arts

characters.breakdown: 像巫师（巫）一样，用语言（讠）施咒陷害别人
characters.memory_tip: Words (讠) twisted like a witch's spell (巫) to curse the innocent — false accusation → 诬

characters.meaning: to frame / trap / sink into / pitfall

components.meaning: a person falling into a pit

characters.breakdown: 在地形（阝）中挖坑，让人（臽）掉进去
characters.memory_tip: A person (臽) falling into a hole in the earth (阝) — trapped in a pit → frame / ensnare → 陷

components.meaning: three mouths — many people judging / tasting

characters.breakdown: 三个人（口口口）一起品评，共同判断品质
characters.memory_tip: Three mouths (口口口) all tasting and judging together — assessing quality → character / grade → 品

characters.breakdown: 每走一步（彳）都保持心地（心）正直（直）
characters.memory_tip: Every step you walk (彳) guided by a straight (直) heart (心) — virtue in action → 德

characters.breakdown: 许多（九）种树木（木）混杂在一起
characters.memory_tip: Many (九) different trees (木) all jumbled together — a mixed variety → 杂

characters.breakdown: 用手（扌）熟练地操控各个分支（支）
characters.memory_tip: Hands (扌) deftly managing every branch and extension (支) — manual skill → 技
